name: Recalls of baby and children's products
description: Recalls of baby and children's products collected every day from US CPSC, US FDA, Lebensmittelwarnung.de, EU Safety Gate and UK OPSS, classified as children's products by Claude Haiku, translated, and de-duplicated across sources. Recalls stay listed for two years after publication. Shown at https://recalls.allo.land/.
attribution: Baby product recalls (spikinglabs), from US CPSC, US FDA, Lebensmittelwarnung.de, EU Safety Gate and UK OPSS
